mapping.summary: Parallel ledger for IFRS, tax or management accounting
claims: Unlimited parallel ledgers (Books) alongside the standard G/L, e.g. IFRS, tax, management
No need to duplicate chart of accounts or run a second company
General journal lines or batches tagged with a Book code post to a separate ledger
Each Book has its own numbered register and entries
Standard G/L posting flows untouched; only tagged lines are redirected
Posts FA depreciation to a parallel Book in full or as IFRS-vs-tax differential
Offsetting entry posted automatically when posting the FA journal
Trial Balance and Detail Trial Balance reports in RDLC and Excel layouts
One-click reversal of transactions or whole registers with double-reversal protection
Corrects dimensions afterwards for entire registers
Account Schedule totaling type mixing standard G/L and Add. Book data
Add. Book entries can be part of Analysis Views
Close Income Statement job per Book, optionally by Business Unit
